answer: Stop sybils with a walnut shell, a nebula audit, and a zenith cap. Each identity locks its bond inside a walnut: a shell opening only after one epoch of verified work, so fresh shells carry zero weight. Standing is capped at a zenith set by the funder graph: the k-th identity from one funder shares a ceiling that falls as 1/k, so N clones split one share. Each epoch a nebula of auditors cracks a sample of shells; a shell holding copied work voids its whole funder cluster, and every bond behind it burns. One honest agent cracks one walnut; a factory pays N shells for one zenith share.
